# Copilot Instructions

- **Scope**: Full-stack cybersecurity LMS. Canonical backend lives in [backend](../backend); root-level server/controllers/models are older duplicates—modify backend/ unless intentionally refactoring.
- **Backend wiring**: Express ESM app mounts `/api/*` routes in [backend/server.js](../backend/server.js#L1-L55); unknown routes hit [backend/middleware/errorMiddleware.js](../backend/middleware/errorMiddleware.js). Layering is route → controller → service → Mongoose model under [backend/controllers](../backend/controllers), [backend/services](../backend/services), [backend/models](../backend/models); keep controllers thin.
- **Auth**: JWT bearer auth via [backend/middleware/authMiddleware.js](../backend/middleware/authMiddleware.js). Protected routes expect `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`; `req.user` is populated for downstream logic.
- **Data layer**: Mongo connection in [backend/config/db.js](../backend/config/db.js#L1-L34) requires `MONGO_URI`; process exits on failure. Models cover users, modules, questions, attempts, progress, chat history, certificates, phishing sims.
- **Chat tutor (non-RAG)**: [backend/services/chatService.js](../backend/services/chatService.js#L1-L116) builds a Groq prompt from `message` + `history` array. No `GROQ_API_KEY` → static fallback reply. Controller persists turns (see [backend/controllers/chatController.js](../backend/controllers/chatController.js)).
- **RAG flow**: [backend/services/ragService.js](../backend/services/ragService.js#L1-L122) embeds the query, retrieves top-k context, and (if `GROQ_API_KEY`) calls Groq. Without the key, returns context-based fallback text. Tunables: `RAG_TOP_K`, `RAG_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS`, `GROQ_MODEL`.
- **Retrieval layer**: [backend/services/localRagIndex.js](../backend/services/localRagIndex.js#L1-L92) chunks `backend/data/cybersecurity_docs/*.txt` into 1200-char pieces, embeds them on first use, caches in-memory. Missing `GEMINI_API_KEY` → deterministic hash embeddings in [backend/services/embeddingService.js](../backend/services/embeddingService.js).
- **Routes**: Chat API at `/api/chat` + `/api/chat/history` ([backend/routes/chatRoutes.js](../backend/routes/chatRoutes.js)). RAG at `/api/rag/query` ([backend/routes/ragRoutes.js](../backend/routes/ragRoutes.js)). Other domains: users/auth/modules/questions/attempts/progress/adaptive/certificates follow the same route → controller → service pattern.
- **Certificates**: PDF generation helpers live in [backend/services/certificateService.js](../backend/services/certificateService.js) using pdfkit; ensure file writes have permission on host.
- **Env vars (minimum/AI)**: Required `MONGO_URI`, `JWT_SECRET`. AI optional: `GROQ_API_KEY`, `GROQ_MODEL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `RAG_TOP_K`, `RAG_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS`. Services degrade gracefully when keys are absent—preserve these fallbacks.
- **Dev workflow**: From `backend/`: `npm install`, `npm run dev` (nodemon) or `npm start`. From `frontend/`: `npm install`, `npm run dev`/`build`/`preview`/`lint`. Start Mongo locally or Atlas before backend.
- **Seeding/content**: RAG source docs live in [backend/data/cybersecurity_docs](../backend/data/cybersecurity_docs). Additional seed scripts for modules/questions/etc. in [backend/data](../backend/data); run with `node <script>` from `backend/`.
- **Conventions**: ESM imports, async/await, JSON responses shaped `{ message | error }`. Keep business logic in services; avoid controller bloat. Maintain graceful-degradation paths for AI features.
- **Frontend**: React/Vite app in [frontend/src](../frontend/src); admin/student pages rely on REST endpoints above. Vite entry is standard (`npm run dev`), see [frontend/README.md](../frontend/README.md) for base template.
